name: Stormbringer: Unstable speeds the Stormflow tick on a critical strike (#2818)
contract: #2818: Unstable (705723) reads 'Your direct damage critical strikes cause your Stormflow to tick $707222s1% faster for $707222d'. Its only effect is SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL -> 707222 on TARGET_UNIT_CASTER, but 705723 has ProcFlags 0 and no spell_proc row, so SpellMgr::LoadSpellProcs skips it (src/server/game/Spells/SpellMgr.cpp:2257) and 707222 is never cast; its only incoming DBC link is 705723. The payload is ordinary native data: 707222 is SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER with EffectMiscValue 19 = SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME (src/server/game/Spells/SpellDefines.h:95), EffectBasePoints -21 / DieSides 1 = -20 %, EffectSpellClassMask[1] 65536 which matches Stormflow's SpellFamilyFlags[1] 65536, and DurationIndex 27 = 3000 ms, i.e. exactly '20% faster for 3 sec'. SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME is only read inside AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic (SpellAuraEffects.cpp:720), so the aura also has to re-derive the running channel's period on apply and on expiry. Stormflow is cast as rank 572867 and Shock as rank 504634, the ranks a level-80 Stormbringer owns. spell_crit_rating 100000 makes the critical strike deterministic. Stormflow carries SPELL_ATTR5_SPELL_HASTE_AFFECTS_PERIODIC, so the tick period is EffectAmplitude 1000 scaled by UNIT_MOD_CAST_SPEED; the expected value is therefore taken as a ratio against the unmodified period measured in the same run, while the haste-free 1000 -> 800 is asserted separately through spell_modifier.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
BASELINE: nothing shortens the Stormflow tick period (SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME on 1000 ms)
SETUP: the baseline Stormflow channel is running
Let the channel settle on its tick period
SETUP: the channel aura exposes a tick period
Unmodified Stormflow tick period
Let the 8000 ms channel run out
Let the Shock cast resolve
SETUP: Shock landed a critical strike
BASELINE: a critical strike grants no Unstable buff
SETUP: Unstable is an active passive
DISCRIMINATING: a critical strike now grants Unstable 707222
Unstable runs within its DBC duration (SpellDuration 27 = 3000 ms)
DISCRIMINATING: Unstable cuts the Stormflow tick period by 20 % (707222 base -21 + die 1)
SETUP: the second Stormflow channel is running
DISCRIMINATING: the live channel ticks at 80 % of the unmodified period
Let the 3000 ms Unstable buff expire during the channel
SETUP: Unstable has expired
SETUP: the channel is still running
The tick period returns to the unmodified value when Unstable expires
